visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A muscular man stands shirtless in a living room, wearing black athletic shorts with white stripes and a silver neck chain. He is in a relaxed posture with his hands by his sides. In the background, a large flat-screen TV is visible, along with a white gaming console and green resistance bands. The lighting is bright and even. (2) The camera performs a fast zoom-in and cut. The man is now intensely flexing his muscles, specifically his chest, abdominals, and biceps. His muscles appear significantly more pumped and defined. A row of seven colorful supplement bottles (white containers with various colored labels) appears arranged at the bottom of the frame. (3) The man continues to pose, placing his hands on his hips to emphasize his V-taper and serratus muscles. He shifts his weight slightly, maintaining a focused expression while displaying his vascularity. The lighting seems to have shifted slightly to create higher contrast on his muscle groups.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: POV：充血前 vs 充血後. [Subtitle]: 沒充血沒聖光沒用力. (2) [Slogan]: 有充血有聖光. [Slogan]: 還有藥師健生活！ [Slogan]: 折扣碼：hhn.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A muscular Asian male with short hair, a silver necklace, a watch on his left wrist, and a large tattoo on his right forearm.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A modern living room with gray wood-paneled walls, a large black TV, a PlayStation 5 console, and some fitness equipment like resistance bands.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a calm, low-energy synthesizer pad and a male voice speaking in a neutral, relaxed Mandarin tone. There is no heavy percussion. (2) At the 4-second mark, a sharp, synthesized whoosh sound effect creates a high-energy transition. (3) Immediately following the whoosh, a high-tempo hip-hop track begins with a strong kick-drum beat and aggressive rap vocals in English. The music is much louder than the initial segment, featuring heavy bass and a bright, percussive texture that continues until the end of the video.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a 'before and after' visual comparison to showcase the subject's physique transformation (pumped vs. unpumped) to grab attention, which then transitions into a promotional endorsement for fitness supplements featuring a discount code.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: On-screen text explicitly mentions a brand name and a discount code, accompanied by the physical appearance of the product bottles.

high_inference.freeDescribe: Typical short-form fitness influencer content focusing on aesthetic transformation and product placement.
